speaker_role: former director of MBA admissions and financial aid at Wharton (UPenn); now runs an essay-review/counseling service (not an undergraduate admissions officer)
commercial_incentive: Podcast promotes his essay review service and counseling; mentions reviewing student essays as a service.
key_insights: Published successful essays are curated as sparkly examples; most students have modest stories, and candid self-aware reflection is more compelling than inflated events.
Depth of involvement over years beats half-measure passion projects like a placeholder website or small fundraiser; readers quickly sense things that do not add up.
Do not compete on views or revenue; describe what you did in your own context and avoid overstating.
Hardships like a learning disability, illness or a death are best stated factually (Additional Information for facts), with the essay focusing on your response and change.
Growth through passive things such as reading or watching a sibling is weak unless it leads to action; quiet contemplation needs to show how it drives change.
Why-school essays need specifics: professors, courses, clubs; abbreviations save space in 250-word limits; identity must be tied to actions taken and planned.
Faith or family culture works if connected to what you do; a voting-with-dad story is strong when it grows into voter drives and a club.
Do not calculate your own GPA on the Common App; unranked class is common and not penalized.
specific_numbers_or_facts: Speaker mentions Cornell's academic essay as about 650 words and many why-school essays at about 250 words.
Speaker says about six weeks remained to early deadlines at recording.
Speaker says Common App asks applicants not to self-calculate GPA and that unranked classes will not count against you.
notable_or_distinctive: An anecdote of fact-checking a student's claimed YouTube channel and website, plus detailed guidance on framing hardship without trauma-dumping.
reliability_notes: Speaker's background is MBA admissions, not undergrad, and he sells essay services; long rambling auto-captions with minor errors; Cornell word count is stated from memory.
